name: Quality Assurance in the Age of AI
outcome: Verify software artifacts and agentic processes using appropriate techniques.
description: Verify the software product, production process, usage workflow and modifications to the agent harness. Build on test-first development to check behaviour, audit agent actions and evaluate model-based judgments against independent evidence.
external: Programming, Git, unit testing and basic software engineering practices.
learn: Select checks for the four verification targets
Audit agent actions and review code against independent evidence
Diagnose failures and evaluate automated judgments
tools: Your chosen CLI (Claude Code or Codex)
moduleDescriptions: Map product, process, workflow and harness failures to independent checks.
Use behavioural tests and a review checklist to catch regressions and unsupported claims.
Inspect logs, approvals, instruction compliance and a bounded automated check.
Compare repeated results with reference evidence; diagnose failures and judge disagreement.
practice: Audit a supplied agent-generated scientific code change and its session evidence.
acceptance: Identify planted defects or constraint violations; support findings with tests, logs and independent review.
prerequisiteRationale: S02 provides context/skill design; S03 provides test-first verification. Both are needed for the four-target QA exercise.
